title: Restored by Grace
story:
A young man once had a broken relationship with his father.

Years of misunderstanding created distance between them.

They stopped speaking.

Even when they lived in the same town, they remained apart.

One day, the father fell seriously ill.

The son heard about it but hesitated to visit.

Finally, he gathered courage and went.

He stood outside the hospital room, unsure.

The father saw him first.

Instead of anger, he reached out his hand.

Tears filled both their eyes.

All the distance of years disappeared in a moment.

They were restored.

In life, sin and brokenness create distance between us and God.

But through Christ, that distance is removed.

We are brought back into peace.

Made holy.

Made blameless.

Fully restored in His presence.
life_lesson: Through Christ, you are reconciled to God and made holy and blameless.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for reconciling me to You through Jesus.

Thank You for forgiving my sins and restoring my relationship with You.

Help me to walk in holiness and peace.

Let me never forget the price of Your grace.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you fully understand the value of being restored to God?

Is there anything making you feel distant from Him today?

How can you walk closer to Him in peace and holiness?
verse:
Once you were alienated from God and were enemies in your minds because of your evil behavior.
But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy in His sight, without blemish and free from accusation.
